<noinclude>Character sheet schema 1 item helper. EQL_CHARACTER_SHEET_ITEM_V1. Supply a canonical item page title, optional tier 0–10, existing numeric item icon ID, reviewed stat lines, optional socket capacity 0–8 and up to eight indexed Exaltations. Optional details contain reviewed descriptive metadata and effect links. This helper computes no game statistics.</noinclude>
